==Poisonous peaches==

[[User:Kefkakrazy|Kefkakrazy]] 02:10, 12 April 2006 (UTC)

:In the real world, peach pits contain a very small amount of poison. However, in the Wheel of Time world, peaches appear to be entirely poisonous, with the pit being the most poisonous part. I was thinking we could add something to that effect to this page... perhaps also make mention of the fact that peach pit has been used as a poison at least once in the books? I remember very clearly that Nynaeve was inspecting something and mentioned powdered peach pit... unfortunately, I have no memory of WHICH book this occurred in.

::Winter's Heart. The assassination attempt on Elayne. The blades had powdered peach pit on them. At a Forsaken gathering later on, I seem to recall one of them mentioning peaches being poisonous, but it was said in a way that implied (to me, at least) that they weren't, in the Age of Legends. --[[User:TheParanoidOne|TheParanoidOne]] 05:34, 12 April 2006 (UTC)
